Unless stated otherwise, every item can only be purchased once by each model. Any model with access to the Armory can buy as many items as it wants. Items with a cost of "-" can not be selected.
Enemy units in close combat lose 1 Initiative to a minimum of 1.
The model gains +6" Movement, +2 Toughness, +3 Wounds, +2 Attacks and the "Bike" ability. It loses the "Character" ability.

During your activation, pick an enemy model within 6" and roll to hit. If the hit is successful, the target must make a Toughness test or become a helpless spawn and removed from play. Character models and Monstrous creatures can't be targeted.
During your activation, pick a target unit within 9". Roll 4D6. For every 4+ the unit suffers a wound with S:4 AP:-5 D:1, Seeking.

One weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +6" Range (only for ranged weapons)
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Deflect" ability.
One enemy psyker per battle-round can be forced to reroll a psychic test to manifest a power.
The model can make an additional attack with the following profile: Range: 24" Type: Assault 1 Strength: 8 AP: -5 Damage: 2, AT(1).
The model can reroll a single die each activation.
When this model is killed, it explodes like a vehicle. Cumulative with "Popping Plague".
The model gains +2" Movement and the "Anti-grav" ability.

A friendly Daemon unit arriving within 3" of the bearer via Deep strike does not scatter. If the arriving unit has the same Mark of Chaos as the bearer, it can instead be placed within 6". Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.
Enemy models reduce their weapons range by 6" (to a minimum of 6"), if they target the bearer or its attached unit.
The unit reduces the amount of Mortal Wounds suffered from Daemonic Instability by 1.
The model may pick 2 additional psychic powers from any general psychic discipline.
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Toughness, +2 Wounds, +1 Attack and the "Bike" ability.
The model is immune against psychic attacks and effects.
The model automatically succeeds at pursuit rolls to catch fleeing units.
The model can manifest 1 more psychic power per activation than usual. If it did not know any psychic powers before, it can pick 1.
The model may re-roll one to hit roll per activation. Must be purchased for each weapon seperately.
All melee attacks of the model gain Poison(2+).
All models of the first enemy unit each round activating within 7" must pass a Toughness test or suffer a wound with S:4 DS:0 D:1 and the "Seeking" ability. Unique.
The model gains Deadly(5+) on one of its weapons. If the weapon already has the rule, increase Deadly(x+) by 1. For example Deadly(5+) becomes Deadly(4+).
Psychic tests of 9 or higher can never be denied.
The model gains +1 Wound and +1 Attack. Only for Heralds.

A friendly Daemon unit arriving within 3" of the bearer via Deep Strike does not scatter. If the bearer has a Mark of Chaos, only Daemons with the same mark can use the icon. Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.
Each time the model casts a psychic power with a 7+, the nearest enemy unit within 21" suffers 1D3 automatic wound with S:4 DS:0 D:1 and the "Seeking" ability.

The model knows one additional psychic power from one of their chosen psychic disciplines. If it already knows all powers from each discipline, it may instead learn one power from a new discipline it has access to. Can be taken multiple times.
Psykers within 18" suffer a "Perils of the Warp" attack on each double when trying to manifest a psychic power. Additionally, they have to roll two dice and apply both peril results.
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, 2 Attacks with the "Warp jaws" weapon (see Screamers) and the "Jet bike" ability.
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, +1 Attack, additional Haste(2") and the "Bike" ability.
The model gains the "Deflect" and "Parry" ability.
Once per round, after killing at least one enemy model, the bearer regains 1 wound up to its maximum. Unique.

After the model loses its last Wound, create a Nurglings unit with 1D3 models as close as possible outside of direct base contact with any enemy unit. The Nurglings get an unused order of your choice.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Retribution(1)" ability.
The model gains a cumulative instance of the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.
The Model and its attached unit gain +1 to all Wound rolls and suffer -1 Toughness.
Enemy models in close combat lose 1 Attack to a minimum of 1.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Furious charge" ability.
The army adds +1 to rolls during the Reinforcement phase. Unique.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Acute Senses" ability.

The model ignores the first "Crew Shaken" vehicle damage each round.

The model can use its Smoke Launcher once per game:
- During normal activation, instead of firing weapons.
- If it has not yet carried out its order this round and is targeted by an enemy unit. The order is consumed by doing so.
Enemy units can only deal glancing hits with ranged attacks until the next activation.
The model does not have to declare its ranged weapons at all targets before firing, and can choose a new target for each weapon.
Equipment such as Icons or Teleport homing beacons do not function within 12" of the model. Additionally, units arriving via Deep Strike that land within 12" roll an additional 2D6 for scattering.
